name: ouat178-wp-mapping-load-uat
description: OUAT-178: opera.correl_product_mapping is empty on UAT, so sp_create_price_ratio_wp builds nothing and WP price and Greeks are zero. Loads the 4 legacy CFS rows (KP, KX, WP, WY) from dbsystemuat.correl_product_mapping_cfs. Insert only. Preview first, no apply without the owner saying so.

source.sql: SELECT TRIM(product_code) AS product_code, TRIM(primary_code) AS primary_code, TRIM(secondary_code) AS secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier FROM dbsystemuat.correl_product_mapping_cfs
